injury_reports.name: Tyson Bagent
injury_reports.summary: With Caleb Williams (hamstring) active, Tyson Bagent will serve as the Bears' backup quarterback against the Falcons on Sunday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Luther Burden III
injury_reports.summary: Burden secured all eight targets for 95 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jonah Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (hip/quadricep) does not have any injury designation ahead of Thursday night's game against the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Roschon Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson rushed 13 times for 51 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-23 win over the Falcons. He caught both of his targets for 34 yards.

injury_reports.name: Colston Loveland
injury_reports.summary: Loveland brought in six of seven targets for 65 yards and a touchdown in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Monangai
injury_reports.summary: Monangai (toe/thumb) has been ruled out for Thursday's game against the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Rome Odunze
injury_reports.summary: Odunze brought in three of four targets for 39 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kalif Raymond
injury_reports.summary: Raymond caught both of his targets for 18 yards and returned three punts for 54 yards during Chicago's win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Zavier Scott
injury_reports.summary: Scott has been elevated from Chicago's practice squad ahead of Thursday's game against the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: D'Andre Swift
injury_reports.summary: Swift rushed 16 times for 44 yards and two touchdowns and brought in four of five targets for 26 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jahdae Walker
injury_reports.summary: Walker went without a target while playing 10 of the Bears' 77 snaps on offense in Sunday's 31-23 win over the Falcons.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding four rushes for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Edwards
injury_reports.summary: Edwards (hamstring) is doubtful to play Thursday night versus the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Keyshaun Elliott
injury_reports.summary: Elliott (quadriceps) was estimated as a full participant on the Bears' official injury report Monday.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Gordon
injury_reports.summary: Gordon posted four solo tackles, including 3.0 sacks, and two forced fumbles during the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Cam Lewis
injury_reports.summary: Lewis returned to Sunday's game against the Falcons, Brad Biggs of the Chicago Tribune reports.

injury_reports.name: Jack Sanborn
injury_reports.summary: Sanborn (concussion) is officially listed as out for Thursday's game versus the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Tyrique Stevenson Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Stevenson (hip) is questionable to play Thursday night versus the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Shemar Turner
injury_reports.summary: The Bears activated Turner (knee) from their reserve/PUP list Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Cairo Santos
injury_reports.summary: Santos made one of his two field-goal attempts and all four PATs in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dayo Odeyingbo
injury_reports.summary: The Bears placed Odeyingbo (quadriceps) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Anthony Johnson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: out

injury_reports.summary: Campbell (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: DeMario Douglas
injury_reports.summary: Douglas caught seven of eight targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-19 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Hunter Henry
injury_reports.summary: Henry caught four of five targets for 48 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-19 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Corey Kiner
injury_reports.summary: Kiner rushed 11 times for 57 yards while also adding 88 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 26-19 win over the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Drake Maye
injury_reports.summary: Maye completed 18 of 32 passes for 235 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed four times for 24 yards in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Morgan Moses
injury_reports.summary: Moses (foot) is questionable to play Thursday versus the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
injury_reports.summary: Stevenson rushed 14 times for 36 yards and wasn't targeted in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kevin Byard
injury_reports.summary: Byard (chest) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Channing Canada

injury_reports.summary: Davis (neck) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Christian Elliss

injury_reports.name: Dre'Mont Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones (shoulder) does not have an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Karon Prunty

injury_reports.name: Charles Woods
injury_reports.summary: Woods (shoulder) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Jets.

injury_reports.name: Craig Woodson
injury_reports.summary: Woodson (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Thursday night's game against the Bears.

injury_reports.name: Andy Borregales
injury_reports.summary: Borregales made both of his field-goal attempts and went 2-for-3 on extra-point tries during the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Marcus Bryant
injury_reports.summary: Bryant (ankle) was a full participant at the Patriots' practice Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Romeo Doubs

injury_reports.name: Mark Andrews
injury_reports.summary: Andrews caught one of three targets for four yards during the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Rashod Bateman
injury_reports.summary: Bateman (shoulder) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Josh Cuevas
injury_reports.summary: Cuevas caught four of five targets for 44 yards and a touchdown during Sunday's 13-10 loss to Cleveland.

injury_reports.summary: Flowers brought in six of 11 targets for 66 yards and rushed once for one yard in the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Matt Hibner
injury_reports.summary: Hibner (hand) was a full participant at practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Justice Hill
injury_reports.summary: Hill caught all three of his targets for nine yards during the Ravens' 13-10 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Huntley
injury_reports.summary: With Lamar Jackson (ankle) being downgraded to out, Huntley will be the Ravens' starting quarterback against the Bengals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Lamar Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (ankle), who has been ruled out out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, was considered close to playing this week and is "likely to return" to action Week 8 versus the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Jurgens
injury_reports.summary: Jurgens (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Kobi Lane

injury_reports.name: Elijah Sarratt

injury_reports.name: Andrew Vorhees
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Kyle Hamilton
injury_reports.summary: Hamilton finished Sunday's 13-10 loss to the Browns with seven tackles (six solo).

injury_reports.name: Jaylinn Hawkins
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Roquan Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith logged five tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, during Sunday's 13-10 loss to the Browns.

injury_reports.name: Broderick Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Washington (ankle) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bengals.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Loop
injury_reports.summary: Loop converted one his two field-goal attempts and his lone extra-point try during Baltimore's loss to Cleveland on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tavius Robinson
injury_reports.summary: The Ravens placed Robinson (pectoral) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Tampa

injury_reports.name: Jordan Addison
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Addison (hamstring) will participate in practice Wednesday, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Max Brosmer
injury_reports.summary: Brosmer (coach's decision) is listed as inactive but will serve as the Vikings' third quarterback for Sunday's games versus the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Demond Claiborne
injury_reports.summary: Claiborne (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: Christian Darrisaw
injury_reports.summary: Darrisaw (concussion) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: T.J. Hockenson
injury_reports.summary: Hockenson (concussion) practiced fully Friday and doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game versus the Colts, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Justin Jefferson
injury_reports.summary: Jefferson (ankle) practiced in full Thursday, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Jauan Jennings
injury_reports.summary: Jennings did not reel in his only target during Sunday's 23-13 win at New Orleans.

injury_reports.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Jones may log fewer touches in Week 7 against Indianapolis on Sunday, as fellow RB Jordan Mason (thumb) is questionable to suit up, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Michael Jurgens
injury_reports.summary: Jurgens (elbow) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Kyler Murray
injury_reports.summary: Murray completed 24 of 30 passes for 229 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions while adding 10 rushes for 51 yards in the Vikings' 23-13 win over the Saints on Sunday. He also recovered a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Caleb Tiernan
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Ben Yurosek
injury_reports.summary: Yurosek (ankle) is listed as active for Sunday's game against the Saints, Craig Peters of the Vikings' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Cashman
injury_reports.summary: Cashman recorded eight tackles (three solo) and a fumble recovery during Sunday's 15-10 win versus the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Charles Demmings
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Joshua Metellus
injury_reports.summary: Metellus recorded nine tackles (four solo), including 0.5 sacks, and a defensed pass Sunday against Tampa Bay in a 23-16 victory.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Rodgers
injury_reports.summary: Rodgers logged six tackles (two solo) and an interception in Sunday's 23-16 victory over Tampa Bay.

injury_reports.name: Jakobe Thomas
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Elijah Williams
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Will Reichard
injury_reports.summary: Reichard made all three of his field-goal attempts and both extra-point tries during the Vikings' 23-13 win over the Saints on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Brett Thorson
injury_reports.summary: Thorson (hamstring) was a full participant in practice Wednesday and Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Donovan Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (knee) was placed on injured reserve by the Vikings on Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Mason
injury_reports.summary: The Vikings activated Mason (thumb) from injured reserve Saturday, and he does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Colts.

injury_reports.name: DeeJay Dallas
injury_reports.summary: The Vikings signed Dallas to the practice squad and elevated him to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.summary: Downs caught four of eight targets for 40 yards in Sunday's 26-20 loss to the Titans. He added seven rushing yards on his only carry.

injury_reports.name: Seth McGowan
injury_reports.summary: McGowan took four carries for 27 yards during Sunday's 26-20 loss versus the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Drew Ogletree
injury_reports.summary: Ogletree (ankle) practiced in full Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Braelon Allen
injury_reports.summary: Allen will remain the Jets' No. 1 back for Sunday's Week 7 matchup against the Dolphins, as Breece Hall has been declared inactive for the contest.

injury_reports.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Cooper may get fewer looks in the passing game Sunday versus Miami with Adonai Mitchell cleared to return from a finger injury, Amanda Vogt of the Jets' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Davis
injury_reports.summary: Davis rushed seven times for 16 yards and caught his only target for 10 yards during Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Breece Hall
injury_reports.summary: Hall (quadriceps) is inactive for Sunday's Week 7 matchup against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Adonai Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: Mitchell (finger) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Dolphins.

injury_reports.name: Max Mitchell
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Kene Nwangwu
injury_reports.summary: Nwangwu (knee) is inactive against the Dolphins on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dylan Parham
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Kenyon Sadiq
injury_reports.summary: Sadiq caught one of three targets for 12 yards in Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Geno Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith completed 20 of 30 passes for 252 yards with one touchdown and one interception while adding two rushes for minus-1 yard in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Mason Taylor
injury_reports.summary: Taylor caught four of six targets for 33 yards during Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Isaiah Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams should continue to serve as the No. 3 wide receiver behind Garrett Wilson and Tim Patrick for Sunday's game against the Patriots due to the absence of Adonai Mitchell (finger).

injury_reports.name: Garrett Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson brought in four of six targets for 44 yards in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Dane Belton
injury_reports.summary: Belton recorded nine tackles (four solo) and a pass defensed during Sunday's 26-19 loss at New England.

injury_reports.name: Jarvis Brownlee Jr.
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Jack Heflin
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Kiko Mauigoa
injury_reports.summary: The Jets placed Mauigoa (quadriceps) on injured reserve Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Joseph Ossai
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Jamien Sherwood
injury_reports.summary: Sherwood recorded 11 tackles (six solo), a forced fumble and a fumble recovery during Sunday's 26-19 loss at New England.

injury_reports.name: Jason Sanders
injury_reports.summary: Sanders made all four of his field-goal attempts and his sole PAT in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tim Patrick
injury_reports.summary: Patrick caught one of three targets for 15 yards during Sunday's 26-19 loss to the Patriots.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Allgeier
injury_reports.summary: Allgeier and Bam Knight will be the Cardinals' top backs for Sunday's game against the Broncos due to the absence of Jeremiyah Love (ankle), Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Carson Beck
injury_reports.summary: Beck (back) is inactive but will serve as the emergency third quarterback against the Broncos on Sunday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Kendrick Bourne
injury_reports.summary: Bourne caught five of eight targets for 47 yards during the Cardinals' 18-16 win over the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jacoby Brissett
injury_reports.summary: Brissett completed 24 of 35 passes for 218 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams. He also rushed twice for two yards.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Brooks
injury_reports.summary: Brooks caught two of three targets for 30 yards and returned a kickoff for 25 yards during Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Jon Gaines II
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Elijah Higgins
injury_reports.summary: Higgins caught all three of his targets for 28 yards during the Cardinals' 18-16 win over the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Evan Hull
injury_reports.summary: The Cardinals signed Hull from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Bam Knight
injury_reports.summary: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the Broncos, so Knight and Tyler Allgeier will be used in tandem in Love's absence, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jeremiyah Love
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Trey McBride
injury_reports.summary: McBride caught seven of nine targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Albert Reese IV
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Michael Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson caught four of seven targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Budda Baker
injury_reports.summary: Baker (groin) is listed as questionable but expected to play against the Broncos on Sunday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Kitan Crawford
injury_reports.summary: Crawford (ankle) is active for Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Max Melton
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Walter Nolen III
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Andrew Wingard
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Chad Ryland
injury_reports.summary: Ryland converted all six of his field-goal attempts during Arizona's win over the Rams on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jonah Coleman
injury_reports.summary: Coleman (ankle) is listed as active Sunday at Arizona, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: J.K. Dobbins
injury_reports.summary: Dobbins rushed 17 times for 41 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for five yards during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Sam Ehlinger
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Evan Engram
injury_reports.summary: Engram caught both targets for 13 yards in Denver's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday night.

injury_reports.name: RJ Harvey
injury_reports.summary: Harvey rushed six times for 25 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 31 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Marvin Mims Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Mims caught two of four passes for 13 yards, returned one punt for 11 yards and returned one kickoff for 24 yards during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Bo Nix
injury_reports.summary: Nix completed 17 of 27 passes for 107 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed four times for two yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday. He also recovered a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Courtland Sutton
injury_reports.summary: Sutton brought in two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Jaylen Waddle
injury_reports.summary: Waddle (chest) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game at Arizona.

injury_reports.name: Kris Abrams-Draine
injury_reports.summary: Abrams-Draine recorded six tackles (four solo), three pass breakups, including an interception, and one forced fumble in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Jonathon Cooper
injury_reports.summary: Cooper had his roster exemption removed by the Broncos on Saturday and is available for Sunday's road game against the Cardinals, Aric DiLalla of the Broncos' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Talanoa Hufanga
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Jordan Jackson
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Brandon Jones
injury_reports.summary: Jones recorded eight tackles (three solo) in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Quan McMillian
injury_reports.summary: McMillian recorded five tackles (five solo), including 1.0 sacks, and a pair of pass breakups, including an interception, in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Riley Moss
injury_reports.summary: Moss (ribs) is available for Thursday's game against the Seahawks, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Onyedim
injury_reports.summary: inactive

injury_reports.name: Alex Singleton
injury_reports.summary: Singleton recorded 13 tackles (four solo) in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks.

injury_reports.name: Pat Surtain II
injury_reports.summary: Surtain (ankle) isn't likely to play Sunday at Arizona, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Wil Lutz
injury_reports.summary: Lutz made his lone field goal and both of his extra-point tries during the Broncos' 17-14 overtime win over the Seahawks on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Badie
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos placed Badie (thumb) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jonah Elliss
injury_reports.summary: The Broncos placed Elliss (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday, Aric DiLalla of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: DeAndre Carter
injury_reports.summary: The Lions signed Carter to the active roster Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
injury_reports.summary: Gibbs rushed 25 times for 151 yards and two touchdowns while bringing in five of six targets for 56 yards in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jared Goff
injury_reports.summary: Goff completed 19 of 30 passes for 271 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions while adding a one-yard touchdown on his only rush attempt in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday. He also committed a fumble recovered by Detroit.

injury_reports.name: Sam LaPorta
injury_reports.summary: LaPorta brought in all five of his targets for 88 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jackson Meeks
injury_reports.summary: Meeks (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against Arizona.

injury_reports.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
injury_reports.summary: St. Brown secured six of 11 targets for 69 yards and committed two fumbles that remained with Detroit in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Isaac TeSlaa
injury_reports.summary: TeSlaa failed to haul in either of his two targets during the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jameson Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams brought in two of four targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in the Lions' 45-21 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Brian Branch
injury_reports.summary: The Lions activated Branch (Achilles) from injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Jack Campbell
injury_reports.summary: Campbell recorded 14 tackles (six solo) during Sunday's 32-26 loss at Carolina.

injury_reports.name: Christian Izien
injury_reports.summary: Izien recorded 11 tackles (seven solo) including 1.0 sacks during Sunday's 32-26 loss at Carolina.

injury_reports.name: D.J. Reed
injury_reports.summary: Reed (ribs) is active for Sunday night's matchup with the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Tyleik Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (foot) is active for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Rock Ya-Sin
injury_reports.summary: Ya-Sin (hamstring) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Jake Bates
injury_reports.summary: Bates made his lone field-goal attempt and converted on all six of his extra-point tries during Sunday's 45-21 win over the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Ben Bartch
injury_reports.summary: The Lions placed Bartch (foot) on injured reserve Friday.

injury_reports.name: Kerby Joseph
injury_reports.summary: Lions head coach Dan Campbell stated Kerby (knee) "is in a good headspace" and expects the 25-year-old to play at some point this season, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.

injury_reports.name: Tom Kennedy
injury_reports.summary: The Lions placed Kennedy (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

injury_reports.name: Cade Mays
injury_reports.summary: Mays (wrist) was activated from injured reserve Saturday and no longer has an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Packers.

injury_reports.name: Devin White
injury_reports.summary: The Lions placed White (forearm) on injured reserve Friday.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Golden

injury_reports.name: Josh Jacobs
injury_reports.summary: Jacobs is expected to start in his season debut Sunday against the Lions, but the extent of his role is likely to be decided upon as the game unfolds, according to Jay Glazer of Fox Sports.

injury_reports.name: Tucker Kraft
injury_reports.summary: Kraft caught five of eight targets for 37 yards in Sunday night's 23-13 win over the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: MarShawn Lloyd
injury_reports.summary: Lloyd rushed eight times for 10 yards while failing to catch his only target during Sunday night's 23-13 win over Dallas.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Love
injury_reports.summary: Love (back) was a full practice participant Thursday, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Bo Melton
injury_reports.summary: Melton (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jacob Monk
injury_reports.summary: Monk (quadriceps) is active for Sunday night's game against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Coleman Owen
injury_reports.summary: The Packers signed Owen from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Pierre Strong Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Strong rushed 11 times for 28 yards in Sunday night's 23-13 win over the Cowboys. He caught five of six targets for 39 yards.

injury_reports.name: Christian Watson
injury_reports.summary: Watson (ankle) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game in Detroit, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Savion Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams (ankle) does not carry an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon Cisse
injury_reports.summary: Cisse (shoulder) does not have any injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions, Wes Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Zaire Franklin

injury_reports.name: Jordon Riley

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Lukas Van Ness
injury_reports.summary: Van Ness (illness) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Lions.

injury_reports.name: Evan Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams recorded six total tackles (five solo) and an interception during Sunday night's 23-13 win over the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Trey Smack
injury_reports.summary: Smack made all three of his field-goal attempts and both of his extra-point tries during Green Bay's win over the Cowboys on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jonathan Ford

injury_reports.name: Luke Musgrave

Home cover edge = home score − away score + home spread = 1.59 points.
Team implied totals: DET (53.5 − (-3)) / 2 = 28.25; GB (53.5 + (-3)) / 2 = 25.25. Market scoring expectations are context only.
Price -108 implies 51.9%; no-vig market 49.6%.
Model win 53.1%, push 3.1%, loss 43.8%; conditional win 54.8%.

injury_reports.name: Brock Bowers
injury_reports.summary: Bowers (hamstring/calf) upgraded to a full practice Thursday, Anthony Galaviz of The Fresno Bee reports.

injury_reports.name: Kirk Cousins
injury_reports.summary: Cousins completed 23 of 41 passes for 313 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Ashton Jeanty
injury_reports.summary: Jeanty rushed 10 times for 22 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of six targets for 36 yards in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Michael Mayer
injury_reports.summary: Mayer brought in seven of nine targets for 95 yards in the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Fernando Mendoza
injury_reports.summary: Mendoza did not play a single snap during the Raiders' 33-30 loss to the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Nailor
injury_reports.summary: Nailor caught one of four targets for nine yards during Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Aidan O'Connell
injury_reports.summary: O'Connell (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Raiders' emergency third quarterback against the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Tre Tucker
injury_reports.summary: Tucker caught five of seven targets for 97 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Mike Washington Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Washington (foot/back) is considered a game-time decision for Sunday's contest against the Rams, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Trey Zuhn III
injury_reports.summary: Zuhn (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Jeremy Chinn
injury_reports.summary: Chinn recorded 10 total tackles (nine solo) during Sunday's 33-30 loss to Buffalo.

injury_reports.name: Nakobe Dean
injury_reports.summary: Dean registered 12 total tackles (three solo) during Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Bills.

injury_reports.name: Tonka Hemingway
injury_reports.summary: Hemingway (concussion) does not have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Patrick Johnson
injury_reports.summary: Johnson (stinger/neck) was a full participant in Wednesday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Darien Porter
injury_reports.summary: Porter is starting at outside cornerback in place of Hezekiah Masses in Sunday's game against the Bills, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Quay Walker
injury_reports.summary: Walker (chest) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Ryan McFadden of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Matt Gay
injury_reports.summary: Gay converted all three of his field-goal attempts and all three extra-point tries during Las Vegas' loss to the Bills on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Carter Runyon
injury_reports.summary: The Raiders have ruled out Runyon (foot) for Sunday's game against the Rams.

injury_reports.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Thornton (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

items.name: Quay Walker
items.impact: Reported Questionable: LB starter availability could change this week's rotation.

items.name: Mike Washington Jr.
items.impact: Reported Questionable: depth at RB may be affected.

items.name: Carter Runyon
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at TE may be affected.

items.name: Dont'e Thornton Jr.
items.impact: Reported Injured Reserve: depth at WR may be affected.

injury_reports.name: Blake Corum
injury_reports.summary: Corum produced 42 yards on nine carries and reeled in both of his targets for 18 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 18-16 loss against the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Higbee
injury_reports.summary: Higbee caught all four of his targets for 22 yards during the Rams' 18-16 loss to the Cardinals on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

injury_reports.name: Alaric Jackson
injury_reports.summary: The NFL reinstated Jackson on Monday after his one-game suspension for punching Bradley Chubb, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

injury_reports.name: Konata Mumpfield
injury_reports.summary: Mumpfield could get a significant bump in opportunity Sunday in Week 7 against Las Vegas since Davante Adams (hamstring) is on IR and Puka Nacua (calf) is questionable to play, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Puka Nacua
injury_reports.summary: The Rams are optimistic that Nacua (calf), who is listed as questionable for Week 7, will play in Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Colby Parkinson
injury_reports.summary: Parkinson caught five of six targets for 31 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Ty Simpson
injury_reports.summary: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback against the Cardinals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Stafford
injury_reports.summary: Stafford was 25-for-33 passing for 222 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions during Sunday's 18-16 defeat against the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Jordan Whittington
injury_reports.summary: Whittington could operate in an expanded role offensively if Puka Nacua (calf, questionable) cannot play against the Raiders on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kyren Williams
injury_reports.summary: Williams notched 10 carries for 50 yards and recorded three catches (on six targets) for 17 yards during Sunday's 18-16 defeat to the Cardinals.

injury_reports.name: Kam Curl
injury_reports.summary: Curl finished Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals with eight tackles (three solo).

injury_reports.name: Eric Kendricks
injury_reports.summary: The Rams elevated Kendricks from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Quentin Lake
injury_reports.summary: Lake registered seven tackles (six solo) and an interception during the Rams' 18-16 loss to the Cardinals on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Nate Landman
injury_reports.summary: Landman (concussion) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Gary Klein of the Los Angeles Times reports.

injury_reports.name: Trent McDuffie
injury_reports.summary: McDuffie (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

injury_reports.name: Brandon McManus
injury_reports.summary: McManus is slated to sign with the Rams, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Davante Adams
injury_reports.summary: Adams (hamstring) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Terrance Ferguson
injury_reports.summary: Ferguson (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve next week, isn't expected to be ready at that time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Poona Ford
injury_reports.summary: The Rams placed Ford (triceps) on injured reserve Tuesday.

injury_reports.name: Myles Garrett
injury_reports.summary: Rams coach Sean McVay said Friday that Garrett (knee) could have his 21-day practice window opened next week, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Blake Grupe
injury_reports.summary: Rams head coach Sean McVay announced Monday that Grupe will miss the remainder of the season after sustaining a torn ACL in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

injury_reports.name: Kobie Turner
injury_reports.summary: The Rams placed Turner (groin) on injured reserve Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Zach Charbonnet
injury_reports.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Charbonnet (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game versus the Chiefs, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

injury_reports.name: Irv Charles
injury_reports.summary: The Seahawks signed Charles off the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: George Holani
injury_reports.summary: Holani is slated to remain Seattle's No. 2 running back Sunday against Kansas City, as Zach Charbonnet (knee) has been ruled out for the contest, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Tory Horton
injury_reports.summary: Horton caught one of five targets for 13 yards and returned a punt for 13 yards during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday. He also logged one tackle.

injury_reports.name: Velus Jones Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Jones turned four carries into 20 yards and caught his only target for minus-1 yard during Thursday's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.name: Cooper Kupp
injury_reports.summary: Kupp caught five of 10 targets for 50 yards during the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Drew Lock
injury_reports.summary: Lock (elbow) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Chiefs, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Rashid Shaheed
injury_reports.summary: Shaheed (hip) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Emanuel Wilson
injury_reports.summary: Wilson will be the lead back for Sunday's game against the Chiefs after Zach Charbonnet (knee) was ruled out ahead of that contest, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Nick Emmanwori
injury_reports.summary: The Seahawks expect that Emmanwori (hip) will play against the Chiefs on Sunday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Ernest Jones IV
injury_reports.summary: Jones recorded nine tackles (five solo), including 1.0 sacks, in Thursday night's 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos.

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Uchenna Nwosu

injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: Elijah Arroyo

injury_reports.name: Anthony Bradford
injury_reports.summary: The Seahawks activated Bradford (knee) from injured reserve Saturday, and he does not carry an injury designation into Sunday's game against the Chiefs, John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Jalen Royals
injury_reports.summary: Royals caught two of his four targets for 24 yards during Kansas City's win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Kenneth Walker III
injury_reports.summary: Walker ripped off 128 yards and two touchdowns on 19 carries and added two catches (on three targets) for 11 yards during Sunday's 22-6 win against the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: Justin Watson
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs elevated Watson from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Xavier Worthy

injury_reports.name: Nick Bolton
injury_reports.summary: Bolton recorded 11 total tackles (three solo) during Sunday's 22-6 win over the Chargers.

injury_reports.name: George Karlaftis

injury_reports.name: L'Jarius Sneed
injury_reports.summary: Sneed (knee) did not fly to Seattle with the Chiefs due to personal reasons but remains questionable for Sunday night's contest.

injury_reports.name: Harrison Butker
injury_reports.summary: Butker made three of his four field-goal attempts and one of two PATs in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Cooper McDonald
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs activated McDonald (knee) from injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Josh Simmons
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs placed Simmons (lower back) on injured reserve Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Brashard Smith
injury_reports.summary: The Chiefs placed Smith (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

injury_reports.name: Saquon Barkley
injury_reports.summary: Barkley (hamstring) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Hollywood Brown
injury_reports.summary: NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports that teams seeking help at wide receiver will likely call the Eagles about the status of Brown before the Nov. 10 deadline.

injury_reports.name: Darius Cooper
injury_reports.summary: Cooper caught one of two targets for nine yards and added 38 yards as a kick returner during Sunday's 25-14 loss to the Panthers.

injury_reports.name: Dallas Goedert
injury_reports.summary: Goedert (knee) was a full participant in Saturday's practice and does not carry an injury designation into Monday's game against the Cowboys.

injury_reports.name: Willie Lampkin
injury_reports.summary: Lampkin (illness) does not have an injury designation against the Cowboys on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Tanner McKee
